name: claude-plugin-repo-ci-release
description: Wire up CI validation and automatic release-cutting for a Claude Code plugin or marketplace repo (one with a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/*). Adds two GitHub Actions — a structure validator on every PR/push, and a release-on-version-bump job that cuts a GitHub Release whenever VERSION changes — plus the bundled validator script and workflow templates. Use when a plugin repo has no CI or its GitHub Releases have drifted behind the shipped version.
